_comment: The bridge from the probe to the GitHub-hosted fleet, measured on one 4-vCPU
machine (Python 3.14.7 and 3.13.18) at R10-HOTFIX-CI-CRITPATH-4's tree, by
replay.py section 5. scripts_s: the two scripts tests/run.sh runs ALONE on the
box -- as CI runs the probe step -- timed alone here; their ratio to the same
scripts' 60-run GitHub medians (fast_scripts.json) is this machine's speed
against the fleet's factor-1 host. probe_s: tests/host_probe.py alone here,
the median of three runs per interpreter. parallel_scripts_s: the fast lane's
other scripts of >= 20 s, run three-wide here as CI runs them, kept to show
the spread a parallel-run bridge carries (disclosed, not used).
